name: Other Fish to Fry
summary: At Shadowprey Village, Drulzegar Skraghook asks you to strike back at the Slitherblade. Naga took the fishing crew near Ranazjar Isle, and Drulzegar alone returned.

sections.title: A Crew Lost
sections.body: Drulzegar Skraghook and the crew often fished near Ranazjar Isle. The isle lies north of a wreck on the coast. One morning, the naga attacked and killed everyone but Drulzegar. Now revenge fills Drulzegar's thoughts, and guilt is too much to bear.

sections.title: Fry the Naga
sections.body: Drulzegar asks you to slay seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses. A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from joining you. The naga usually lurk far down among coral reefs beneath the waves, Drulzegar says. Your effort will be rewarded.

aliases: who gives other fish to fry
faq.answer: Drulzegar Skraghook is a fisherman at Shadowprey Village in Desolace. The naga killed the whole crew near Ranazjar Isle, leaving Drulzegar as the only survivor.

faq.q: Where did the attack on Drulzegar's crew happen?
faq.answer: The naga attacked beside Ranazjar Isle, north of a wreck on the coast. The crew often fished there, and the attack came one morning.

faq.q: Why doesn't Drulzegar fight the naga himself?
faq.answer: A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from fighting the naga. Drulzegar says they would help you kill them if not for the injury. Guilt over the crew weighs heavily on Drulzegar's conscience.

faq.q: Where do the Slitherblade naga lurk?
faq.answer: Drulzegar says the Slitherblade naga usually lurk far down among coral reefs beneath the waves. The crew was attacked near Ranazjar Isle.

faq.q: Which naga does Drulzegar want eliminated?
aliases: what naga need to be killed
faq.answer: Drulzegar wants seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses slain.
